meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: Claude 会将网站部署到 Vercel 并上线;会先检查代码构建,再验证网址可访问,也可管理项目、域名和环境变量。
howto.when: 当被要求部署或发布 web 应用,或管理 Vercel 项目、域名和环境变量时。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会执行生产部署并返回线上网址。

say.text: 查看我在 Vercel 上的项目列表
say.note: Claude 会列出你名下的项目。

say.text: 给项目 example.com 添加域名
say.note: Claude 会将域名添加到当前项目。

howto.what_en: Claude deploys websites to Vercel, verifying the build first and checking the live URL after deploy. It can also manage projects, domains, and environment variables.
howto.when_en: When asked to deploy or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Claude deploys and returns the live URL.

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to the project
say_en.note: Claude adds the domain to the current project.
